chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Hearing the Hadacol Caravan on the radio
summary: Back in New York, Danny heard the radio announce the Hadacol Caravan with Bob Hope and Mickey Rooney, with no Black stars, and they never heard from the Senator.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: So you sent it to him, and what happened, Danny?

We're back in New York, and we're sitting down, and I'm eating... We're in the kitchen. And I'm eating fish, and I've got the radio on. And we're eating fish and a potato salad, enjoying ourselves. And I hear the radio say, "And from Hollywood, here's the Hadicol(?) caravan. Senator Dudley Lebeau of Louisiana is opening up a big show, the Hadicol Caravan. It's a road show and it's

going from here...from here in Nevada, and they're going from St. Louis to Chicago to New York City to Madison Square Garden. This is the greatest show ever done, old-time, old-fashioned medicine show, featuring the sensational product, Hadicol. Starring Bob Hope, Mickey Rooney, Jimmy Durante and Judy Garland" -- and with that Daniels boy, that little young boy that's like Mickey Rooney. All them people. And Jerry Corona(?). They had all of Bob Hope's people and Jimmy Durante and all that's coming to the Garden. "The great Hadicol Caravan."
I said, "Mmm, wait til he comes to the Madison Square Garden. I'm going out there and check him." They ain't got a first(?) Black star nowhere. No artist at all.
And nothing has happened with us, and we're ...(?)
And the bus... We just barely get to New York and put the bus in a parking lot, with them brand-new tires on it. And we're there. So I'm ready to get in the harness again, going out and hustling.
So the show never did get to the Madison Square Garden, because some big medicine people, some big concern, I forget the name of them big medicine people...one of them...
You wrote them a letter. We never did get an answer.
